actor.name: CPTPP (Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership)

relations_to.summary: Argentina formally requested accession to the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership, announced by Foreign Minister Pablo Quirno around the Mercosur summit of 29-30 June 2026. The CPTPP has twelve members, including Japan, Canada, Australia and the United Kingdom, so accession needs the consent of London while Argentina sanctions firms operating in the Falklands (our observation). Uruguay is named as another possible individual applicant; Brazil answered with a Mercosur-Japan negotiation.

sources.title: Milei brings open disputes with Brazil to a Mercosur summit focused on trade deals

relations_to.summary: Party to the CPTPP (in force Dec 2018); took part in the 10th Commission's ministerial statement of 26 Jun 2026 (Vietnam chair), which recorded the substantial conclusion of Costa Rica's accession and preparatory talks with Uruguay, the UAE, the Philippines and Indonesia.
